onboarding.tour.content.title: Your store's content
onboarding.tour.content.body: Your name, logo and phone are already on your store. Here you edit what makes it yours: the cover, your values, your story. Open a page to change its sections.
onboarding.tour.product.title: Add your first product
onboarding.tour.product.body: Your store shows what you add here. Create your first product with a name, price and photo.
onboarding.tour.store.title: See your online store
onboarding.tour.store.body: Open your store or share its link and QR code with your customers. You can replay this tutorial from your profile.
onboarding.restart.title: Your guided tutorial
onboarding.restart.description: Explore the workflows available to your role: products, customers, orders, documents and your store.
onboarding.restart.error: Couldn't restart the tutorial. Try again.
onboarding.label: Explore Tsuru
onboarding.away: You are in a different section. Return to see this control highlighted, or continue to the next step.
onboarding.missing: This control is not visible yet. You can keep reading, continue, or revisit this step when the page is ready.
onboarding.welcome.title: Get comfortable with your workspace
onboarding.welcome.body: Follow the real controls for the tasks available to your role. You can close the tour whenever you like and replay it from the book button above.
onboarding.welcome.count: {count} short steps, adapted to your access. The tour only explains actions; it does not save or send anything.
onboarding.guide.title: Getting started
onboarding.guide.body: Keep these examples nearby while you work. This guide follows your current organization and permissions, just like the tour.
onboarding.guide.before.title: Before you start
onboarding.guide.before.body: Check that you are in the right organization and role. Use existing customers, products and orders when you have them. Review prices, quantities and customer details before saving. Electronic invoicing also needs configured fiscal information, credentials and an active branch and terminal.
onboarding.guide.help.title: Need a hand?
onboarding.guide.help.body: Open Support from here or your account menu. Describe the task, the section, the steps you took and the result you expected. Include the order or document reference when relevant, and review your message before sending it.
onboarding.step.overview.title: Understand your overview
onboarding.step.overview.body: Switch between orders and documents to understand what your dashboard totals represent. These are different workflows, so their numbers can differ.
onboarding.step.overview.example: Compare today’s orders with today’s documents using the source tabs.
onboarding.step.overview.result: The overview updates to the selected source and your permitted scope. A sale or order is not created.
onboarding.step.organization.title: Check your business identity
onboarding.step.organization.body: This section holds your organization’s name, description, logo and business type. Review them here; contact and fiscal settings have their own sections.
onboarding.step.organization.example: Check that the name and logo match the business you are working with.
onboarding.step.organization.result: The current business details are shown. Changes take effect only when an authorized user edits and saves them.
onboarding.step.create-product.title: Add a product
onboarding.step.create-product.body: New product opens a form. Add the name, price and the details your business needs; review the category, photo and tax settings before saving.
onboarding.step.create-product.example: Prepare a product with a clear name, a price and a photo. Check your existing catalog first to avoid duplicates.
onboarding.step.create-product.result: The product becomes available after you save it. The tutorial does not open or submit the form for you.
onboarding.step.products.title: Find a product
onboarding.step.products.body: Use the catalog’s search and filters to find an existing product. Your current role can consult this section; creation and editing depend on separate permissions.
onboarding.step.products.example: Find a product by name and open it to check its price and details.
onboarding.step.products.result: You can review the product you selected without changing the catalog.
onboarding.step.create-client.title: Keep customer details ready
onboarding.step.create-client.body: New customer opens the customer form. Search for an existing customer first, then check the identification and contact information you need for your work.
onboarding.step.create-client.example: Prepare a customer’s name, identification and email, then review the form before saving.
onboarding.step.create-client.result: The saved customer can be selected in later workflows. Missing or incorrect details should be corrected before issuing a document.
onboarding.step.clients.title: Find an existing customer
onboarding.step.clients.body: Search the customer directory and open the record you need. Your current role can consult customers; creating or editing needs separate permissions.
onboarding.step.clients.example: Find a customer by name or identification and review their contact details.
onboarding.step.clients.result: The selected customer’s saved information is available for review.
onboarding.step.create-document.title: Choose the work you need to create
onboarding.step.create-document.body: The plus button offers only the document and manual-order types available to your role and business setup. Electronic documents require fiscal configuration; a manual order is a separate workflow.
onboarding.step.create-document.example: After the tour, choose the type you need, select an existing customer and products, and review quantities, taxes and payments.
onboarding.step.create-document.result: A draft opens only when you choose a type. Creating a draft does not issue it; review the final action before confirming.
onboarding.step.documents.title: Review an existing document
onboarding.step.documents.body: Use the search and filters to locate saved documents in the ledgers you can access. Open a real document to check its details and available actions.
onboarding.step.documents.example: Find a saved document by its reference, then review its receiver, totals and current status.
onboarding.step.documents.result: The detail shows the saved document and its processing status. If no documents exist yet, return after your first one is issued.
onboarding.step.orders.title: Follow an order
onboarding.step.orders.body: Find an existing order using the search and filters. Open it to review its lines, delivery information, status and the actions permitted for that order.
onboarding.step.orders.example: Open an order that actually exists and compare its ordered quantities with its current delivery details.
onboarding.step.orders.result: You see the selected order’s saved information. If the list is empty, create or import an order through the authorized workflow first.
onboarding.step.content.title: Make your storefront yours
onboarding.step.content.body: Each page card opens its content sections. Choose the page you want to review; editing and publishing depend on your permissions and the storefront configuration.
onboarding.step.content.example: Open a page and review its cover, text and images before making an authorized change.
onboarding.step.content.result: You see the selected page’s sections. If no pages are configured yet, set up the storefront before returning to this step.
onboarding.step.share-store.title: Share your store
onboarding.step.share-store.body: This button opens your store’s link and QR code. Check the store’s configuration and published content before sharing it with customers.
onboarding.step.share-store.example: After the tour, open the store link yourself and check it before sharing the link or QR code.
onboarding.step.share-store.result: The sharing dialog shows the store address when available. A store that is not configured needs setup before it can be shared.
onboarding.step.profile.title: Your profile and help are always nearby
onboarding.step.profile.body: Your profile contains your personal details, security options and tutorial replay. The book button in the top bar also restarts this tour, and Getting started stays in navigation.
onboarding.step.profile.example: Check your profile, then keep the Getting started guide available while you complete your first task.
onboarding.step.profile.result: You can return to the guide or replay the tour whenever you need it. Closing the tour saves your choice.
onboarding.step.sessions.title: Prepare your working session
onboarding.step.sessions.body: Sessions organize the working shift and its assignments. Open an existing session to review its configuration before starting operational work.
onboarding.step.sessions.example: Select your actual working session and confirm the branch, terminal and assigned people.
onboarding.step.sessions.result: You see the saved session and available actions. Starting or closing a session is a separate, explicit action.
onboarding.step.reports.title: Read totals in context
onboarding.step.reports.body: Check the report’s date range and scope before interpreting its sales, payment and tax figures. Reports describe saved activity.
onboarding.step.reports.example: Review the displayed date range and compare the totals with the relevant saved documents.
onboarding.step.reports.result: You can interpret the figures for the stated reporting period. Export actions are offered only to roles with export permission.
